fusions.name: Textbook Stoop
fusions.desc: Dives onto a target up to 9 tiles away for 28 damage, rising to 2 times that at the full 9 tiles. The blow ignores the target's armour.

fusions.name: Opening Form
fusions.desc: Looses 3 feathers in a spread, each dealing 2 damage. Against a target nothing has wounded yet, each feather has 30% more critical chance.

fusions.name: Second Pass
fusions.desc: Wheels you 3 tiles from where you stood and clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting.

fusions.name: Drilled Manoeuvres
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 7% sooner, and your dodge chance rises by 6%.
